category_definition.wrong-polarized: p_update >= 0.90 and delta_q_expected < 0, or p_update <= 0.10 and delta_q_expected > 0
category_definition.correct-polarized: p_update >= 0.90 and delta_q_expected > 0, or p_update <= 0.10 and delta_q_expected < 0
category_definition.non-polarized: All remaining rows; no zero-delta polarized rows occurred.

decision_rules.POLICY_SATURATION_OBSERVED: YES iff strongly-saturated rate >= 0.50 for both checkpoints; else NO.
decision_rules.WRONG_POLARIZED_STATES_HAVE_WEAK_CORRECT: YES iff wrong/nonpolarized score median ratio <= 0.25 for both; NO iff >= 0.75 for both; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rules.EXPECTED_BINARY_GRADIENT_VANISHES_IN_WRO: YES iff wrong/nonpolarized expected-gradient median-abs ratio <= 0.25 and mean-abs ratio <= 0.50 for both; NO iff both >= 0.75 for both; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rules.SATURATION_ASSOCIATED_WITH_SMALL_TRIGGER: YES iff 9-head Spearman rho >= 0.50 for both; NO iff rho <= 0 for both; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rules.CACHE_TRIGGER_PREMATURE_DETERMINIZATION_: YES iff saturation, weak corrective score, and vanishing expected binary gradient are all YES; NO if saturation is NO or both attenuation signals are NO; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rules.SYMMETRIC_REFERENCE_ALONE_LIKELY_SUFFICI: NO when premature determinization is supported because symmetric direction remains attenuated by p*(1-p); YES only when premature determinization is rejected and prior symmetric diagnosis justifies a reference fix; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rules.ENTROPY_OR_EXPLORATION_REGULARIZATION_JU: YES as a mechanism-level follow-up when premature determinization and policy saturation are both supported; does not select a coefficient or authorize a change.

5e-4.definition: Spearman across 9 heads: symmetric-sample saturation-margin median vs A_GLOBAL production trigger cache_encoder grad-norm median over 12 minibatches.

1e-3.definition: Spearman across 9 heads: symmetric-sample saturation-margin median vs A_GLOBAL production trigger cache_encoder grad-norm median over 12 minibatches.
